characters.name: Narrator
characters.description: The all-knowing yet unseen storyteller who guides the audience through the story.

characters.name: Elion
characters.description: An ancient but eternally youthful deity with powerful hidden abilities and the protagonist of the story.

characters.name: Iris
characters.description: A mortal woman of exceptional beauty and grace, who captures Elion's heart despite being unaware of his divine nature.

plot: Our story sets in a world similar to Earth, at a time far in the past. The protagonist, Elion, is an ancient deity with incredible power and wisdom, trapped in an eternally youthful form. He lives among humans to understand their world and appreciates their creation's beauty. Despite his wise and ancient essence, Elion fails to understand human emotions, a curiosity that finds a direction when he meets Iris. Iris is a mortal of exceptional grace and beauty who captures Elion's heart. As they spend more time together, Elion starts to comprehend the thrill of human companionship and the joy of a new day through Iris. Iris, unaware of Elion's deity nature, finds him intriguingly different. Elion cherishes their growing bond, finding himself increasingly sympathetic with human feelings and more confused about his own, wondering if what he feels could indeed be called love.
recap: In a world and time not quite our own, the ancient deity Elion, disguised in a youthful form, finds the mortal beauty Iris. Iris, unaware of Elion's true nature, befriends him. Elion further explores his empathy for human emotions, finding solace in Iris's company. The mundane experiences of a human morning spark joy in the deity, an emotion new to him. Meanwhile, his complex feelings for Iris deepen, leaving him in a state of bafflement and intrigue, exploring the unchartered territories of what appears to be love.
